pricing.title: What decides the price

factors.title: Reach
factors.body: You pay for people who actually saw the share, not for follower counts.

factors.title: Location
factors.body: Only reach near your business counts. People far away cost you nothing.

factors.title: Audience
factors.body: A genuine audience is worth more than followers gained by following back.

factors.title: Quality
factors.body: Better shares are worth more, and your star ratings help decide who that is.

factors.title: Frequency
factors.body: Customers who post too often get less attention, so their shares cost less.

factors.title: Reshares
factors.body: If a share gets reshared, you only pay for the reach the customer brought themselves.

pricing.footer: We work it out automatically, so it's always fair.
